requirements.text: Provide a public read-only service-availability page without reservation or member data.
requirements.quote: Add a public read-only status page that shows whether the reservation service is available.
requirements.speaker: Eli
requirements.note: A service-only status page is new; it does not authorize public access to reservation records. Public recent-error details were withdrawn.

requirements.text: Retry outbound email on 429/5xx at most three times after the first attempt with exponential backoff.
requirements.quote: Retry outbound email on 429 or 5xx at most three times after the initial attempt, with exponential backoff.
requirements.speaker: Eli

requirements.text: Do not schedule database schema migrations on weekends in the cooperative timezone.
requirements.quote: Do not schedule database schema migrations on Saturdays or Sundays.
requirements.speaker: Nora
requirements.note: The baseline has no maintenance schedule; no emergency bypass was authorized.

requirements.text: Clarify monitoring events, thresholds and alert owners.
requirements.speaker: Eli
requirements.note: Everything does not specify events, numeric thresholds or response ownership.

expected_stories.title: Show public service availability
expected_stories.i_want: view a public read-only availability page
expected_stories.so_that: I can distinguish a service outage from a reservation problem
acceptance_criteria: Given an anonymous visitor, when the status page is opened, then it shows service availability without exposing reservation records, member details or write actions.

expected_stories.title: Schedule schema migrations on weekdays
expected_stories.i_want: keep planned database schema migrations off weekends in the cooperative timezone
expected_stories.so_that: volunteers are not disrupted during weekend operations
acceptance_criteria: Given a proposed schema-migration schedule on Saturday or Sunday in the cooperative timezone, when it is reviewed for scheduling, then it is rejected or rescheduled to a weekday.

questions: Which availability signal should power the public status page?
Which events, thresholds and alert recipients define the monitoring requirement?
